name: Supabase

A.name: App moves, BaaS stays
A.rule: the POC plugs into a DEV Supabase project of the developer, never production; source untouched (no login, no signup, no write)

B.name: Data moves, Auth stays
B.rule: PostgreSQL add-on accessed server-side; RLS rewritten with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; browser .from() calls move to server routes

C.name: Full exit
C.rule: auth in the app (or Keycloak where the zone has it), files to Cellar served with nosniff + CSP sandbox, functions to routes; detailed method in modules/supabase/GUIDE.md

traps: Testing the source by logging in WRITES to it (sessions, refresh tokens, last_sign_in_at, sequences): source = read-only SQL only.
Landing A: the Clever URL must be added to the Auth redirect allow-list by the developer, on a dev project.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* are build-time: set before the first build.
A service_role / sb_secret_ key in a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name is a leak: stop and tell the developer.

Storage migrated to an app route changes the files' origin: serve with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and CSP 'default-src 'none'; sandbox', inline only png/jpeg/webp/gif, refuse text/html and image/svg+xml.
Test the code path the app really uses (private bucket → /storage/v1/object/authenticated/…, not the public URL).
Health data: landing A keeps data on Supabase; sovereignty/HDS only holds for B or C in parhds.
